title: 02  电脑版剪映视频剪辑.mp4
origin: User-provided local Jianying tutorial; abstracted principles, not a bundled preset.

route_semantics.typed: Supported technique.2.0 fields; build and validate an explicit graph.
route_semantics.recipe: Executable builder producing a typed graph.
route_semantics.workflow: Existing main workflow; separate confirmation and evidence remain required.
route_semantics.external: Not bundled; exact resource/voice/preset needs explicit licensed input.
route_semantics.knowledge: Planning abstraction only; no new automatic detector or segmentation implementation.

techniques.name: 非破坏剪裁与轨道合成
techniques.intent: 把素材变成可重排的片段；分开源区间、时间线位置和层级。

operations: trim adjusts source range without deleting source
paste copy at playhead on adjacent z track
compose transformed layers in z order

parameters.transform: scale uniform, translation px or normalized, rotation degrees

code_expression.timing: duration=(out-in)/speed; still image duration is independent of source length

pitfalls: 教程为旧版剪映，插入与自动吸附语义应由当前工具显式决定。
不要以删除源文件来实现时间线删片。
validation: 源区间在素材时长内；预览首尾能恢复修剪；高轨图像实际覆盖低轨。

techniques.name: 统一画布、模糊背景与叠层
techniques.intent: 处理不同画幅素材并允许上下轨混合。

operations: blend_mode applies per-pixel combine before opacity

parameters.blur_strength: four UI choices; sigma mapping unknown

code_expression.timing: background and foreground share clip interval

pitfalls: 必须显式指定画布，不能让首素材无意决定整个成片画幅。
样式背景依赖实际图像资源；四档模糊与Gaussian sigma不等价。
validation: 看画面边缘、模糊背景接缝和叠层透明度；核对输出宽高。

techniques.name: 变速、定格与反放
techniques.intent: 把时间变换表达成可执行采样函数。

operations: freeze: split at source t and insert repeated decoded frame

parameters.preserve_audio_pitch: separate boolean; audio quality requires listening

code_expression.timing: seconds; freeze shifts subsequent timeline clips by freeze duration

pitfalls: 定格会增加时间线总长。
示例里的变调开关不证明处理后音质；未试听不能标记合格。
validation: 冻结前后运动连续；静帧恰为指定长度；变速源出点不越界。

techniques.name: 调节与人物效果边界
techniques.intent: 把常规颜色参数与专有美颜/动画资源区分。

parameters.units: these are Jianying UI sliders, not exposure stops or physical Kelvin

code_expression.timing: color per clip; entry/exit animation within clip boundaries

pitfalls: 不能把同名滑块的数值直接当成FFmpeg滤镜物理参数。
专有瘦脸/磨皮/组合动画需要原资源或声明近似；本课未提取算法。
validation: 比较肤色与边缘光晕；锐化不能补回失焦细节；检查动画首尾。

unknowns: 本地ASR全文读完但未听审，个别词如播放/静止/剪映识别错误；视觉支撑主要位于证据帧。
旧版应用的精确颜色曲线、四档模糊sigma、变声与人物算法、动画内建曲线未确认。
